hostInfo.name: Appart'City
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Appart-Hôtel Appart’City Confort Tours offers comfortable, 3-star self-contained accommodation with private parking (available at an additional cost) and free Wi-Fi. The reception is open 24/7 and no Air-conditioning.
Our 110 fully furnished apartments include ceramic hobs, a refrigerator, a microwave, a dishwasher (in one- and two-bedroom units only), a kettle or coffee maker, dishes, and kitchen utensils.
From twin studios to spacious three-room apartments that can accommodate up to 6 guests, our accommodations are ideal for both business trips and family stays.
You’ll also appreciate the dedicated workspace and LCD screens available in all our apartments. Some “Superior” category units feature a terrace or balcony—feel free to contact our team for more information.
For a worry-free stay, take advantage of our à la carte services such as housekeeping and laundry.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: They say you can't have it all. Comfort or adventure ? Work or relaxation ? Freedom or hotel services ? What if we replaced “or” with “and” ? Welcome to Appart’City, France's leading aparthotel brand with over 90 destinations across France and Europe. We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: The location of our aparthotel is ideal: in a quiet area yet near all the necessary amenities, the shopping centre, restaurants, a cinema, a bowling alley and the university. Culture and history lovers will appreciate the easy access to the historic centre by tram and to the area's major roads, so that they can visit the châteaux of the Loire, see local wine cellars and vineyards and enjoy a bike ride along the Loire River.
